task.instructions:
Using matplotlib, draw a time-series line chart of monthly website sessions.
There are 18 monthly observations, one for the first day of each month from 2023-01-01 through 2024-06-01 inclusive, in chronological order:
  41283, 39764, 45120, 47893, 52410, 49877, 46325, 48901, 57342,
  61208, 66754, 71430, 68215, 70988, 79341, 83126, 88407, 92735
Requirements:
- Plot exactly one line. Its x values must be real date objects (for example `datetime.date(2023, 1, 1)` or a pandas Timestamp), one per month start, so that matplotlib renders a genuine date axis. Do not pass the months as strings or as 0..17 integers.
- Label the line `Sessions` and show a legend.
- The y axis must start at 0.
- Turn on a grid.
- Give the chart a title and label both axes.
